mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS <= 0.5%) is associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days, as it reduces the cost of capital and encourages risk-taking in equity markets.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in more than 50% of all instances, or the Rank IC between FEDFUNDS and 20-day returns is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) rises above 7.5% in the past month, it signals economic distress that leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in more than 50% of instances when UNRATE > 7.5%, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is low (<=0.5%) and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is high (>7.5%), it indicates a weak economy with low interest rates, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 50% of instances when FEDFUNDS <= 0.5% and UNRATE > 7.5%, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the quarterly real GDP (GDPC1) compared to the previous quarter signals economic contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in more than 50% of instances when GDPC1 declines, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the CPI (CPIAUCSL) rises above 2.5% annually, it signals high inflation that erodes corporate profits and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 50% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 2.5%, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) are below 900 and industrial production (INDPRO) is below 95, it indicates weak demand and supply, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 50% of instances when HOUST < 900 and INDPRO < 95, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: High inflation (CPIAUCSL > 2.5%) is associated with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 days, as it increases the risk of monetary tightening and reduces equity valuations.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in more than 50% of all instances, or the Rank IC between CPIAUCSL and 5-day returns is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 95, it signals a contraction in the manufacturing sector, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 50% of instances when INDPRO < 95, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.
